title: 第502章 财富自由第501章 私活
slug: 你好是寄往魔神堡垒的信吗
lines: 林鬼的目光落在那堆木箱里清一色的校服上，眉头微微皱起。
“你这是接了运送衣服的私活？”
他侧过头看着艾尔维亚。
“你不是在铜门城挣了很多钱吗？那些还不够你花？”
运输队选拔会开始前，七币邮局运输队的赔率几乎高到离谱。
没有人会压在一支包含一个高阶、两个下位超凡，还临时从晨星改成烈阳的奇葩组合上。
绝大多数人都觉得这是来闹着玩的。
甚至有好事者专门去下注这支队伍会死在路上。
结果，不死烈阳的公告贴出来之后，铜门城的自杀率飙升了一截。
而艾尔维亚，也挣到了这辈子都不用林鬼包养就能花天酒地的钱。
两个亿的下注资金，并不是林鬼撬门开锁偷到的。
自上次他将铜门城大贵族金库祸祸一遍后，大贵族们的金库已经严防到丧心病狂的程度。
至于那两个亿，是艾尔维亚用三件半神器作为抵押，从黑市上贷出来的。
风语者权杖，以及卡斯和维克多的两把武器。
三件半神器也贷不出两个亿，最多一亿四千万左右。
但艾尔维亚愣是靠着自己的谈判技巧，多弄出了几千万。
所以赌资有她的一份。
靠着那场下注，她直接财富自由了。
所以林鬼更不理解对方接私活的举动。
“你接这个私活做什么？”
他低头看了一眼木箱里那些叠放整齐的校服，又抬头扫了一圈满院的木箱。
“而且，看着这皇家魔法学院的校服，你接的活应该是把绿荫廷的衣物运送到千塔之都吧？”
艾尔维亚笑着点了点头。
林鬼又问了一句。
“报酬多少？一百万？”
按照骸骨高地的难度和这段路的距离，一趟护送衣物到千塔，撑死也就这个数了。
甚至连一百万都够呛。
从绿荫廷到千塔之都，连黄金冒险团都能跑下来的路，不可能给出更高的报酬。
况且，这些堆满起来，估计重量都不足一吨。
艾尔维亚笑眯眯地看着他，伸出一根手指晃了晃。
“一个金币。”
林鬼愣住了。
“一个金币？”
“对，就是一个金币。”
艾尔维亚站直身，走到他面前，拍了拍他的肩膀。
“是银丝商会拜托我，将这些货物送到千塔之都。”
content_en:
Lin Gui's eyes fell on the uniform school uniforms in the pile of wooden boxes, and he frowned slightly.
"Did you take the private job of transporting clothes?"
He turned his head and looked at Alvia.
"Didn't you make a lot of money in Tongmen City? Isn't that enough for you?"
Before the transportation team selection meeting began, the odds for the seven-coin post office transportation team were almost ridiculously high.
No one would put pressure on a strange combination that included a high-level, two low-level extraordinary, and temporarily changed from the morning star to the blazing sun.
Most people think this is a joke.
There are even some good people who specifically bet that this team will die on the road.
As a result, after the announcement of the Immortal Fierce Sun was posted, the suicide rate in Tongmen City soared.
And Elvia has also earned enough money to spend her whole life living and drinking without having to be supported by a forest ghost.
The 200 million betting funds were not stolen by Lin Gui by breaking the door and unlocking it.
Since the last time he caused trouble to the treasury of the great nobles in Tongmen City, the treasury of the great nobles has been guarded to the point of madness.
As for the two hundred million, Alvia used three and a half artifacts as collateral to loan it out on the black market.
The Windspeaker Scepter, as well as Cass and Victor's two weapons.
Three and a half artifacts cannot be borrowed for 200 million, and the maximum is about 140 million.
But Alvia relied on her negotiation skills to get tens of millions more.
So she has a share of the gambling capital.
With that bet, she became financially free.
Therefore, Lin Gui did not understand the other party's behavior of taking on private work.
"Why did you take this private job?"
He lowered his head and glanced at the neatly stacked school uniforms in the wooden box, then raised his head and scanned the wooden boxes all over the courtyard.
"Besides, looking at the uniform of the Royal Academy of Magic, your job should be to transport the clothes of the Green Palace to the Capital of Thousand Towers, right?"
Alvia smiled and nodded.
Lin Gui asked again.
"How much is the reward? One million?"
According to the difficulty of the Skeleton Highlands and the distance of this stretch of road, escorting clothes to Thousand Towers would only be enough to survive.
Even one million is enough.
From the Green Pavilion to the Capital of Thousand Towers, a road that even the Golden Adventure Group could travel down, it was impossible to give a higher reward.
Besides, when piled full of them, they probably weigh less than a ton.
Alvia looked at him with a smile, stretched out a finger and shook it.
"A gold coin."
Lin Gui was stunned.
"A gold coin?"
"Yes, it's just a gold coin."
Alvia stood up straight, walked up to him, and patted his shoulder.
"The Silver Silk Chamber of Commerce asked me to deliver these goods to the Capital of Thousand Towers."
title_en: Chapter 502: Freedom of Wealth Chapter 501: Private Life
